run_pnacl_sz_compiler: run the pnacl-sz compiler on an llvm bitcode file to translate to Subzero instructions
run_pnacl_sz_assemble_output: run pnacl-sz with --assemble to assemble the translated output into an object file
run_pnacl_sz_disassemble_output: run pnacl-sz with --disassemble to disassemble the assembled output with objdump
run_pnacl_sz_target_architecture: run pnacl-sz targeting a specific architecture like x8664, arm32, or mips32
run_pnacl_sz_sandboxed_code: run pnacl-sz with --sandbox to generate sandboxed NaCl code
